approximationNotes: Two broadside images do not metrically determine hidden thickness or internal bolt geometry.

Strict CS2 silhouette target 0.90 is not yet met; the current front/back masks are 0.8121/0.8011. The source-fit magazine envelope is retained while the receiver-parented bolt and muzzle-side barrel band are locked.

Scope loop 4 replaces the floating-looking rectangular clamp frames with two coaxial torus rings, clamp tops, saddles, and rail mounts. The rings are now independently attached and included in the world-space seam gate; hidden clamp machining remains inferred.

The crown decal now conforms to the objective bell in both x taper and y circular section. A tighter source crop/mask makes the crown/skull clearer, and it passes the AABB seam gate, but foil separation remains below the target identity score from orbit/side-by-side review.
Trigger and telescoping bipod remain real attached components; visual review still finds the trigger/magazine proportions, crown artwork scale, bipod silhouette, and global envelope below 0.90.
Medusa paint is a shell-only curved projection from supplied pixels; it is not used as structural geometry.
The thumbhole is a real extruded stock cut with a projection cutout; hidden thickness and interior hardware remain inferred.
